notes: Value is None; the rate is per 600 plate appearances (hitters) or 700 batters faced (pitchers).
Best at each position: players whose primary position it is (most games there; pitchers by role), with at least half the leaderboard floor.
Next season: a Marcel-style projection of the WAR rate (three seasons, regressed, aged) times Marcel's playing time.

Prospect value: expected MLB WAR over the next four seasons (discounted 8% a year) from the season's minor-league line at the player's highest level: level, age against the level's mean, performance against the level's (OPS; strikeouts minus walks per batter faced), sample. A log-link regression on the 2015-2022 cohorts (0 for a player who never reached the majors). Stat lines only, no scouting grades.
